title: Phonon31m-CoreML/v0.4.0: native first generated audio
scope: Known English text request to first non-empty generated PCM through the actual native adapter; separate muted native playback checks for Qwen/Phonon.
summary: Warm median 7.80 ms across 5 back-to-back runs; first synthesis after preparation 8.32 ms. Result saved, child joined and owned model removed.

limitations: Generated PCM is not audible output or speech-end-to-answer latency.
Same-text back-to-back warm runs; human-paced performance, language quality and full-duplex reference acceptance remain open.
Normal owner apps and inherited swap pressure retained; no default promotion or installed-app acceptance.
Child peak RSS excludes external host services and is not Mach physical footprint.

method: Known English text is sent through the actual native voice adapter after preparation. Five back-to-back warm same-text requests are summarized separately from the first synthesis after preparation.
The clock stops at the first nonempty generated PCM buffer. It does not stop at a speaker, a microphone, or the end of a conversational turn.
findings: Warm median 7.80 ms across 5 back-to-back runs; first synthesis after preparation 8.32 ms. Result saved, child joined and owned model removed.
Generated audio can be ready before playback starts. Use the separate physical speaker reports before drawing a conclusion about how quickly someone hears this voice.
report.purpose: How quickly can this voice produce its first usable audio buffer? This isolates generation from the separate wait for playback and sound.
